products.name: Conventional Loan
products.description: Homebuyer with good credit score above 680 and stable employment looking for competitive interest rates. Has saved enough for a solid down payment of 5 to 20 percent. Established credit history with manageable debt-to-income ratio. May be purchasing a primary residence, second home, or investment property. Looking for flexibility in loan terms between 15 and 30 years with no government program requirements.

products.name: FHA Loan
products.description: First-time homebuyer with limited savings and a credit score in the low to mid 600s. May have had past credit challenges or a thin credit file. Looking to buy a modest home in a suburban or urban area with a small down payment of around 3.5 percent. Income is moderate, possibly a young professional or growing family getting started in homeownership for the first time.

products.name: VA Loan
products.description: Active duty military service member, veteran, or military spouse looking to purchase a home. Has served in the armed forces including Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, or Coast Guard. Eligible for Department of Veterans Affairs benefits. Wants to buy a primary residence with no down payment required and no private mortgage insurance.

products.name: Jumbo Loan
products.description: High-income professional or household with combined earnings above 200 thousand dollars looking to purchase a luxury or high-value property priced above 750 thousand dollars. Excellent credit score above 720 with substantial assets and reserves. Purchasing in an expensive real estate market. Has significant savings for a large down payment of 10 to 20 percent.

products.name: USDA Loan
products.description: Moderate income family looking to purchase a home in a rural area or small town outside of major metropolitan centers. Household income is below the area median. Wants to live in a farming community, agricultural area, or designated rural zone. Looking for an affordable home with no down payment required in a less populated area.
